Since several ministers have been given organization roles, it indicates their continuation in government may be unlikely. title: SIR row: Will annul EC orders not in keeping with law, says Supreme Court
description: The Supreme Court has asked the Election Commission to clarify decision-making processes related to voter roll revisions. It emphasized that decisions should be taken unanimously or by majority among commission members only. Senior advocate Vikas Singh argued for preserving records and scrutiny of the commission's actions. The court will examine allegations of unilateral actions against the Chief Election Commissioner.

title: Lucknow floods: Why city got flooded days after the rain stopped
description: Lucknow has faced flooding in several neighborhoods due to upstream rainfall runoff. Local rainfall alone is not responsible for the resulting waterlogging in the city. Officials indicate that the runoff from upstream catchments has taken about eight to ten days to reach Lucknow. Urbanization and encroachment on the river's floodplain have exacerbated the flooding situation. Experts expect gradual improvement as runoff emissions begin to stabilize in the coming days.

title: 'If SIR excludes citizens from voters list, what is its purpose?': Bombay HC to EC

The court highlighted the importance of ensuring only citizens are on these rolls during special revisions. Justices emphasized that the process must not result in falsely excluding eligible voters. The Election Commission's guidelines and requirements for form submissions were scrutinized for being inadequate. The hearing on this matter will continue in subsequent sessions.

title: Pakistan, Saudi, Turkiye activate Mecca defence pact as Yemen war escalates

Following recent attacks by Yemen's Houthi group, the three countries will activate collective deterrence measures. The emergency meeting of the Mecca Defence Alliance in Riyadh led to this commitment. Saudi-backed forces are also launching an offensive against the Houthis in Yemen to regain control.

title: Before triple murder, Bengaluru techie used AI to ‘rehearse’ attack scenarios
description: In a shocking incident in Seegehalli, Bengaluru, techie J Kenneth allegedly murdered his partner's family. He had used artificial intelligence to research various methods of attack prior to the crime. Shwetha, Kenneth's partner, had borrowed substantial loans to support him, causing family tension. Following a confrontation with her parents about the loans, Kenneth reportedly carried out the violent act. Authorities continue to investigate the circumstances surrounding this tragic event.

title: Naomi Osaka’s family mission: How did her Haitian roots inspire her work?

Her inaugural trip to Haiti occurred in October 2017, followed by another visit after her first Grand Slam win in 2018. Engaging with local children, she championed educational initiatives and allocated part of her earnings for earthquake relief. This connection deeply influences Osaka's ongoing philanthropic endeavors.

title: Travis Kelce’s $5.35m mansion: Why does it have a $1.75m twin in Illinois?
description: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million Ohio mansion, Moyenage, has a fascinating architectural connection to a $1.75 million home in Wheaton, Illinois. Both properties were designed by architect Jarvis Hunt for steel magnate Jay C. Morse, with the Ohio estate reportedly based on his earlier Illinois residence. The 10,000-square-foot House of Seven Gables retains historic details, including fireplaces, oak panelling, beamed ceilings and carved woodwork, despite being relocated in 2017.
